background: Bank of Scotland plc is one of the ring-fenced banks of Lloyds Banking Group, trading as Bank of Scotland and Halifax, funded by UK retail deposits and lending mainly on residential mortgages.
synthesis: Rated AA- on average across all three, the weakest of them at A+, all three on a stable outlook, after a one-notch upgrade by one of the three on 12 May 2026. Capital is mixed against UK majors: CET1 of 14.1% is in the top quarter but leverage of 4.7% is below the peer median. Liquidity is adequate, LCR of 143% at the median and NSFR of 123% below it. CET1 has risen 0.7 points since 30 Jun 2024 and leverage 0.5 points since 30 Sep 2025, both moving the right way.
